# age_identity (Ephemeral Resource)

Generates an age identity (private key) and its recipient (public key) without storing either in state or plan.

A new identity is generated every time the ephemeral resource is opened, which is on every plan and apply. Pass it to a write-only argument that is only sent when its version changes, such as `password_wo` and `password_wo_version` on `onepassword_item`: the identity is then written once, and later runs generate one that is thrown away.

Requires OpenTofu 1.11 or Terraform 1.10 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generate a post-quantum identity and write it straight to 1Password, without
# it ever reaching state or plan. A new identity is generated on every run, but
# password_wo is only sent when password_wo_version changes, so the one in
# 1Password stays put. Bump the version to rotate.
ephemeral "age_identity" "backup" {
  post_quantum = true
}

resource "onepassword_item" "backup_identity" {
  vault    = var.vault_id
  title    = "backup-age-identity"
  category = "password"

  password_wo         = ephemeral.age_identity.backup.identity
  password_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `post_quantum` (Boolean) Generate a post-quantum hybrid identity (ML-KEM-768 + X25519, `age-keygen -pq`) instead of an X25519 identity. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `identity` (String, Sensitive) The identity: `AGE-SECRET-KEY-1...`, or `AGE-SECRET-KEY-PQ-1...` with `post_quantum`. This is the format of an age identity file.
- `recipient` (String) The recipient: `age1...`, or `age1pq1...` with `post_quantum`. Pass it to `age_encrypted.recipients`.
